pages.text: Use a single-block container or machine item in the $(l:qcraft:qblocks/faces)face recipe$(/l). Once that face is visible, use it normally. Hold the observation with a powered observer if you want it to stay active.

pages.title: Independent Faces
pages.text: A hidden face pauses and stores its contents and settings. Two faces of the same chest type have separate inventories. Mining the qBlock returns its configured item with the saved faces.

pages.title: Machine Limits
pages.text: Use standalone machines. Blocks that rely on a multiblock structure or special placement may need that structure to function. Quantum Computer region swaps still require cargo without block entities.
